# One file spending US dollars before any cost basis is kept for them and after
# one opens.
#
# The dollars first come in borrowed, in a transaction written wholly in US
# dollars, which states no cost and opens no cost basis — so spending 10.00 of
# them and then 5.00 more states no guid and is not refused: there is none to
# state, and the second spend is answered from what the first found. Then 100.00 USD
# are bought at 1.30, which opens one. The same spend after that draws on a
# cost basis the book now keeps, and stating no guid is refused.
#
# Whether the book keeps a cost basis is remembered through an import, because
# it is asked of every spend that states no guid. This file is what shows that
# the answer is forgotten when a cost basis opens.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_whether_a_cost_basis_is_kept_is_asked_again_once_one_opens.py.
2036-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2036-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2036-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2036-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2036-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2036-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: "Liability"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2036-01-01 open Liabilities:USD Loan
	type: "Liability"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2036-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2036-01-01 open Equity:Opening
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2036-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 1000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -1000.00 CAD

2036-01-05 * "Borrow 500.00 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:USD Bank 500.00 USD
	Liabilities:USD Loan -500.00 USD

2036-01-10 * "Sell 10.00 USD before any cost basis is kept"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank -10.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "-14.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank 14.00 CAD

2036-01-12 * "Sell 5.00 USD, still before any cost basis is kept"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank -5.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "-7.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank 7.00 CAD

2036-01-15 * "Buy 100.00 USD at 1.30"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "130.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -130.00 CAD

2036-01-20 * "Sell 10.00 USD after a cost basis opened"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank -10.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "-14.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank 14.00 CAD
